faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What does a move really cost?
faq.a1: The price comes from volume, distance and access — not from the number of rooms alone. A 3.5-room flat with a lift and parking at the door is far cheaper than the same flat on the fourth floor without a lift. The indicative quotation planner uses the same factors we do; after a survey or photo check it becomes a binding written offer.
faq.q2: How quickly can you take a job?
faq.a2: Usually within a week, in an emergency within 48 hours. Month-end is the busiest period — if you are moving then, get in touch early.
faq.q3: What happens if something is damaged?
faq.a3: We carry transport insurance and business liability cover. Damage is recorded in the report the same day and settled through the insurer — you don't have to chase it.
faq.q4: Do you use your own staff?
faq.a4: Yes. Registered, insured staff on collective-agreement wages, no day labour. At peak times we bring in vetted partner firms on the same terms.
faq.q5: Do you handle complete tenant changeovers for property managers?
faq.a5: Yes. Clearance, cleaning, handover attendance and defect rectification as a single indicative quotation package. Framework agreement from ten units a year.

j4.body: Confirm online. We reserve the crew, the vehicle and the cleaning slot.
